headline: Indian Markets Mixed Amid Global Cues; IT and Tata Stocks Under Pressure
why: Higher US Treasury yields are weighing heavily on global investor sentiment
BofA warned of potential Fed rate hikes above 5 percent in a 2022 redux
Investor sentiment plunged to a 16-month low according to the AAII survey
Weakness in the IT sector and Tata group stocks is dragging down the Sensex
whatHappening: Nifty and Sensex are showing mixed performance at the market opening
SBI reports potential 5 trillion rupee profit from FCNR(B) deposits over five years
Air India is considering consolidating its budget units to reduce operational costs
Toyota plans significant annual automation spending of 6.4 billion dollars from 2028

summary:
Indian markets opened mixed as Nifty edged higher while Sensex dipped due to IT and Tata group weakness.
Global sentiment remains cautious following a plunge in investor confidence and rising US Treasury yields.
Banking stocks like SBI are in focus due to projected FCNR(B) profits, while Paytm remains under observation.
